text: No, the tree cover did not change on this property in 2026. The latest available satellite data (from 2025) shows no detectable loss of tree cover greater than 0.5 hectares between 2021 and 2025. The evidence only covers up to the end of 2025, so it cannot confirm changes in 2026. However, the 2025 data shows 43.3 hectares of forest cover remained stable. Any smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or those narrower than 30 meters would not be visible in these observations.
